description: This file defines functions to generate dashboard data, charts, and number cards for manufacturing dashboards in an ERP system, including external module references and specific dashboard configurations.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Returns a dictionary with dashboards, charts, and number cards data.

methods.name: get_dashboards
methods.description: Returns a list of dashboard configurations including charts and cards.

methods.name: get_charts
methods.description: Generates and returns a list of dashboard chart configurations based on company data.

methods.name: get_number_cards
methods.description: Creates and returns a list of number card configurations for the dashboard.
